title: Make supported-app catalog searchable and show local source readiness
summary: Give the 12-app static viewer a searchable source picker and a read-only localhost readiness API so missing local repos or exports fall back directly to configured remote sources.
acceptance_criteria: Supported app cards filter by name, repository, platform, description, and badge with a live result count and useful no-results state.
The local helper exposes a GET/HEAD catalog response with read-only source readiness and without revealing local repo paths or invoking generators.
Cards distinguish existing, generatable, missing export, missing repo, unavailable helper and URL-only states.
Clicking Load skips an unavailable local resolver and uses the known raw URL while still surfacing real generator errors.
Static hosting, demo loading, URL prefill, native bridge, and exports remain intact.
Focused tests and repository verification are executed before ticket closure.

evidence.note: Isolated V8 harness parsed the web app and passed search/count/empty state, local ready/generatable/missing, helper-unavailable fallback, rejected endpoint mismatch and 12-app catalog ID parity. Node/Python checkout tests still pending.
Implementation creates read-only local readiness responses separately from export generation.
Catalog filtering, local readiness labels and URL fallback are implemented on the Ivan 8 topic branch.
Connector-only repository access; cannot run the repo script or its Python environment in this chat.
Full node/browser/runtime checks remain pending on a checkout with dependencies and localhost access.
